title: James and the Giant Peach
author: Roald Dahl
summary: After his parents are lost, young James lives with two horrid aunts until a magic potion grows a gigantic peach in the garden. He climbs inside and sets off across the sea with a crew of oversized insects.
readIf: you want a short, silly adventure with cheerful nastiness and a lot of imagination.
skipIf: you dislike dark, exaggerated humour or cruel villains.

pairings.reason: The same author's most famous tale of a poor boy and a wild, wonderful place.
Another cruelly treated child who finds strength and a happy ending.
Another Dahl story pairing a small child with an unlikely giant friend.
